android.desc:
Clear TV Web Browser is free to download and free to use, without any limitations: native Android TV application which features familiar lean-back TV experience. From Portugal, with love.

Features:
• Mouse pointer! Navigate and click using Android TV remote.
• Scroll mode / Pointer mode for easy navigation.
• Fully private: your web traffic goes directly to your Android TV. We don't know who you are or what are you looking at.
• Full screen video support.
• Zoom in/out where available.
• Web site card preview and favicons.
• Tabs, bookmarks, history.
• Everything you expect from any web browser.

We may show occasional ad to support further development.

Clear TV Web Browser is under active development. If you notice any problems or have a suggestion don't hesitate to contact us. We will always do our best to improve the app. Feedback and reviews are more than welcome.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I Made a Decent Android TV Web Browser

quotes.text:
After some effort to find decent Android TV Web Browser that can work without hacks and support basic 'mouse' navigation using TV remote, I wrote one myself.

Doesn't spy at all and has no idea what you are looking at. All the traffic goes directly to Android TV device with no intermediary servers. Under active development so with feedback it can only get better.

Very useful, very decent performance, will always remain free, will never spy on you.

Web site:

http://iberapps.com/

Google Play:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.iberapps.cleartvwebbrowser
